name: lumis-scope-guard
title_zh: 一份会咬人的「非目标清单」
tagline_zh: 你列一句「不许用 requests」，它就生成 CONSTITUTION.md 和 .cursorrules。
tagline_en: List a non-goal, get deny rules, hooks, CONSTITUTION.md, .cursorrules, plus a startup ritual and drift check.
desc_en: Turn a list of Non-Goals into enforceable boundaries for the coding agent — deny rules and hooks that block forbidden dependencies, paths and keywords, a CONSTITUTION.md and a .cursorrules section — plus a startup ritual and a drift check for any plan. No model, no account, stdlib Python.
why_zh: 不是提示词软约束，而是把禁令落成文件里的硬规则和钩子，Agent 每次开工先读宪法。
why_en: Turns 'don't' into enforceable file-level rules and hooks, not prompt suggestions. Agent reads the constitution first; drift.
limit_zh: 只处理你明确列出的 Non-Goals，不推断隐含边界；生成的规则是文本，不拦截已运行的进程。
limit_en: Only covers explicit Non-Goals; no inference. Rules are text files, not runtime sandbox. Requires agent that honors .cursorrules or similar.
title_en: A Non-Goals list that bites, wired into your Agent's repo
